company_name: Institute Of Optics And Electronics Chinese Academy Of Sciences
semiconductor_relevance: Medium — The Institute of Optics and Electronics focuses on optoelectronic technologies and materials science relevant to semiconductor applications.
summary: The Institute of Optics and Electronics, part of the Chinese Academy of Sciences, conducts advanced research in optoelectronic technologies. It is involved in the design and fabrication of optoelectronic devices, contributing to telecommunications, imaging systems, and sensor technologies. The institute also works on photonic integrated circuits and laser technologies for semiconductor applications.
capabilities: Design and fabrication of optoelectronic devices
